participant_id.Description: A unique participant identifier of the form sub-<label> matching a participant entity found in the dataset

ImageCount_Basque.Description: Number of fMRI images acquired during Basque task
ImageCount_Basque.Source: Task fMRI session for Basque task, NeuroLingua dataset

ImageCount_English.Description: Number of fMRI images acquired during English task
ImageCount_English.Source: Task fMRI session for English task, NeuroLingua dataset

ImageCount_Spanish.Description: Number of fMRI images acquired during Spanish task
ImageCount_Spanish.Source: Task fMRI session for Spanish task, NeuroLingua dataset

age.Acq1.Description: Participant age at first MRI session

eduYears.Description: Approximate years of education, estimated from attainment level and birth year
eduYears.Source: Self-reported education years, approximated from birth year and Spanish education system

ehi_1.Description: Participant’s score on the Edinburgh Handedness Inventory (-100 = left, 100 = right)

EHI_Writing.Description: Handedness for writing, from EHI single item

KBIT.composite.Description: Composite IQ score using Spanish KBIT
KBIT.composite.Source: Kaufman Brief Intelligence Test (KBIT), Spanish version

KBIT.matrices.Description: Non-verbal matrices subtest score, Spanish KBIT
KBIT.matrices.Source: KBIT non-verbal matrices subtest, Spanish version

KBIT.vocabulary.Description: Verbal vocabulary subtest score, Spanish KBIT
KBIT.vocabulary.Source: KBIT verbal vocabulary subtest, Spanish version

Basque.Description: Participant’s rank of Basque as first, second, or third language

English.Description: Participant’s rank of English as first, second, or third language

L1.Description: Participant’s first language(s) based on AoA
L1.Source: Derived from self-reported AoA and language background

Spanish.Description: Participant’s rank of Spanish as first, second, or third language

AoA.Self_Basque.Description: Self-reported age when participant was first exposed to Basque
AoA.Self_Basque.Source: Self-report questionnaire on Basque Age of Acquisition

AoA.Self_English.Description: Self-reported age when participant was first exposed to English
AoA.Self_English.Source: Self-report questionnaire on English Age of Acquisition

AoA.Self_Spanish.Description: Self-reported age when participant was first exposed to Spanish
AoA.Self_Spanish.Source: Self-report questionnaire on Spanish Age of Acquisition

DiffEsEu.AoA.Description: Normalized difference in AoA between Spanish and Basque (-1 to 1), negative = Basque < Spanish, positive = Spanish < Basque
DiffEsEu.AoA.Notes: Normalized by max absolute difference (capped at 18 years)

DiffEsEu.Exposure.Description: Normalized difference in language exposure between Spanish and Basque (-1 to 1), negative = Basque > Spanish, positive = Spanish > Basque

Exposure.Self.Basque.Description: Self-reported categorical exposure to Basque (<50% or >50%)
Exposure.Self.Basque.Source: Self-report questionnaire on Basque language exposure

Exposure.Self.Basque_Perc.mean.Description: Mean percentage of exposure to Basque across reading, writing, speaking, and hearing

Exposure.Self.English.Description: Self-reported categorical exposure to English (<50% or >50%)
Exposure.Self.English.Source: Self-report questionnaire on English language exposure

Exposure.Self.English_Perc.mean.Description: Mean percentage of exposure to English across reading, writing, speaking, and hearing

Exposure.Self.L1_Perc.mean.Description: Mean percentage of exposure to first language across modalities

Exposure.Self.Spanish.Description: Self-reported categorical exposure to Spanish (<50% or >50%)
Exposure.Self.Spanish.Source: Self-report questionnaire on Spanish language exposure

Exposure.Self.Spanish_Perc.mean.Description: Mean percentage of exposure to Spanish across reading, writing, speaking, and hearing

DiffEsEu.Proficiency.Description: Normalized difference in language proficiency between Spanish and Basque (-1 to 1), negative = Basque > Spanish, positive = Spanish > Basque

Proficiency.BEST65.Score_Basque.Source: Basque picture naming part of the BEST (de Bruin, Carreiras & Duñabietia, 2017)

Proficiency.BEST65.Score_English.Source: English picture naming part of the BEST (de Bruin, Carreiras & Duñabietia, 2017)

Proficiency.BEST65.Score_Spanish.Source: Spanish picture naming part of the BEST (de Bruin, Carreiras & Duñabietia, 2017)

Proficiency.Composite.Basque.Description: Normalized mean across all Basque proficiency measures

Proficiency.Composite.English.Description: Normalized mean across all English proficiency measures

Proficiency.Composite.Spanish.Description: Normalized mean across all Spanish proficiency measures

Proficiency.Interview_Basque.Description: Normalized score across interview types to a common scale.
Proficiency.Interview_Basque.Source: Basque Interview score derived from: - Score on the Basque language competence interview part of the BEST (de Bruin, Carreiras & Duñabietia, 2017); interview score
Proficiency.Interview_Basque.Notes: BEST interview originally had 13 levels coded as: -1,1,+1, -2,2,+2, -3,3,+3, -4,4,+4, 5; transformed into a common 0-10 scale.

Proficiency.Interview_English.Description: Normalized score across interview types to a common scale.
Proficiency.Interview_English.Source: English Interview score derived from: Score on the Basque language competence interview part of the BEST (de Bruin, Carreiras & Duñabietia, 2017); interview score
Proficiency.Interview_English.Notes: BEST interview originally had 13 levels coded as: -1,1,+1, -2,2,+2, -3,3,+3, -4,4,+4, 5; transformed into a common 0-10 scale.

Proficiency.Interview_Spanish.Description: Normalized score across interview types to a common scale.
Proficiency.Interview_Spanish.Source: Spanish Interview score derived from: Score on the Basque language competence interview part of the BEST (de Bruin, Carreiras & Duñabietia, 2017); interview score
Proficiency.Interview_Spanish.Notes: BEST interview originally had 13 levels coded as: -1,1,+1, -2,2,+2, -3,3,+3, -4,4,+4, 5; transformed into a common 0-10 scale.

Proficiency.LextalePerc.Score_Basque.Source: Basque version of Lextale lexical decision task (de Bruin, Carreiras & Duñabietia, 2017)

Proficiency.LextalePerc.Score_English.Source: English version of Lextale lexical decision task (Lemhöfer & Broersma, 2012)

Proficiency.LextalePerc.Score_Spanish.Source: Spanish version of Lextale lexical decision task (Izura, Coetos & Brysbaert, 2014)

Proficiency.Self.Basque.Description: Computed as mean across separate ratings for reading, writing, speaking and comprehension OR as global measure.

Proficiency.Self.English.Description: Computed as mean across separate ratings for reading, writing, speaking and comprehension OR as global measure.

Proficiency.Self.Spanish.Description: Computed as mean across separate ratings for reading, writing, speaking and comprehension OR as global measure.

bilingualism.Description: Indicates whether participant is monolingual or bilingual/multilingual
bilingualism.Source: Derived from self-reported L1/L2/L3 and number of languages

IndexBilingEsEu.composite.Description: Average of normalized differences for AoA, Exposure, and Proficiency (Spanish–Basque)

IndexTriLingA.Description: Trilingual index (Basque, Spanish, English), average of mean AoA, Exposure, Proficiency × (number of languages - 1)
IndexTriLingA.Source: Computed from mean AoA, Exposure, Proficiency across Basque, Spanish, English

IndexTriLingB.Description: Trilingual index (Basque, Spanish, English), average of mean AoA, Exposure, Proficiency × number of languages
IndexTriLingB.Source: Computed from mean AoA, Exposure, Proficiency across Basque, Spanish, English
IndexTriLingB.Notes: 0 = no languages, 1 = Monolingual, 2 = two languages, 3 = three languages

LingEnv.Self_Perc.multiling.Description: Percentage of time spent in multilingual context
